post.description:
Retroactive actions (dates in the past) are allowed: a station may record an action already
taken. Completion still needs the action to have started (ADR-036).

get.description: Officers who can be assigned an action at ``station`` (for those who propose or approve there).

post.description:
Fill the briefing template from insights an analyst has **validated** (each one cited). For
reviewers (``ai.insight.review``: analysts; stewards for data-quality insights). A draft for the
analyst to edit; nothing is stored, sent or exported.

Refuses prohibited questions; otherwise ``503 feature-disabled`` (no approved language model).
The question is never stored or logged (its length only).

schema.title: Response Copilot Query Api V1 Ai Copilot Queries Post

get.description:
Insights the caller may see, most confident first. Pending insights of a switched-off model
are not listed (they cannot be reviewed).

post.description:
Validate or dismiss an insight, with a note (audited). Validation records the analyst's
judgement only: it changes no record and creates no action.

get.description: The model registry: model cards, approval, rollout gates and switches.

post.description:
A model's kill switch (needs a sign-in in the last 5 minutes). Switching on requires an
approved model and, for forecasting and language models, every rollout gate (database rule).

get.description: An insight's input snapshot: the run's parameters, input counts and exclusions, and hash.

post.description:
The global AI kill switch (``ai_assistance``). Copilot and forecasting can be switched on only
when their model is enabled (so only after its rollout gates are met).
Called by the BFF once, right after the OIDC code exchange. Records LOGIN in the audit log.

get.description: Boundaries currently in force, as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection (coordinates to ~1 m).

schema.title: Response Current Boundaries Api V1 Boundaries Get

post.description:
Dual-control approval (ADR-026). The caller must hold the slot's permission and a fresh login
*before* anything about the boundary is revealed; the database function then re-checks the
approver (taken from the session, never from the request) and separation of duties.

get.description:
Version history, authorised against the unit's region (``lineage.read`` is region-scoped
for stewards and global for auditors and administrators).
Regions and stations in the caller's aggregate territory (reference data: not audited).

When the active feeds last delivered data, for the always-visible safeguard strip. Exposes
feed names, times and health status only: no counts, territories or records.
Filter values inside the caller's map territory only.

post.description: 'Flag data issue' from the popup: a USER-detected issue for the data steward's queue.

get.description:
Map layer: approved event markers and (unreviewed by design) observations with a point, in
the caller's territory, optionally limited to the map's period (by occurrence, IST).

schema.title: Response Map Records Api V1 Map Operational Records Get

get.description:
Pending records are listed for reviewers (``opsrecord.approve``); everything else for anyone
who may create records, within the territory of that permission.

schema.title: Response List Permissions Api V1 Permissions Get

get.description: The caller's own unexpired exports (row-level security: requester only).

Items waiting for this caller, with the next step they may take (each item's history is at
``/workflow-history``). Pattern reviews: awaiting your decision, or your drafts and returned
reviews. Actions: awaiting your approval, or approved, started and waiting for completion where
you may complete them. Outcomes: completed actions (not by you) without an outcome review, or
your draft (due 28 days after the action ends). Filters: priority, region, owned by you,
overdue.

schema.title: Response List Roles Api V1 Roles Get

get.description: Who did what, when and why, for one Review Queue item the caller may see.
